facts.text: The resort is perched more than 6,500 feet above sea level amid an alpine landscape dominated by Jabal Akhdar, the Green Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Perched more than 6,500 feet above sea level, this luxury resort sits amid an alpine landscape dominated by Jabal Akhdar itself

facts.text: The resort sits in a clifftop setting about an hour outside the ancient city of Nizwa.
facts.excerpt: is perfectly camouflaged into its clifftop setting just an hour outside the ancient city of Nizwa

facts.text: The design takes inspiration from the region's ancient forts, using traditional building techniques, fort-like doors, wooden rafters and Omani design motifs.
facts.excerpt: Alila Jabal Akhdar takes inspiration from the ancient forts in the region using traditional building techniques, fort-like doors, wooden rafters and Omani design motifs

facts.text: Locally sourced materials and classic-style stonework are combined with contemporary architecture.
facts.excerpt: Locally sourced materials and classic-style stonework combine with contemporary architecture

facts.text: The suites and villas are built from mountain stone and adorned with hand-painted juniper leaves by local artists.
facts.excerpt: Built from mountain stone and adorned with hand-painted juniper leaves by local artists

facts.text: Rooms have built-in fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: Woven rugs and hand-painted juniper leaf murals supply a dose of warmth, as do built-in fireplaces.

facts.text: The resort has an expansive infinity pool with views of the Green Mountain and a heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Take in views of majestic Green Mountain from our expansive infinity pool or opt for the serenity and privacy of our heated indoor pool.

facts.text: The spa fuses time-honored Asian healing practices with traditional beauty formulas crafted from natural elements.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the fusion of time-honored Asian healing practices and traditional beauty formulas crafted from natural elements

facts.text: A signature wellness experience includes a Balinese massage in a spa pavilion overlooking the canyon, beneath open sky.
facts.excerpt: Arrive at the spa pavilion overlooking the canyon and enjoy a personalized Balinese massage beneath open sky.

facts.text: The resort's garden is home to one of Oman's first high-altitude hydroponic systems in a luxury resort.
facts.excerpt: home to one of Oman's first high-altitude hydroponic systems in a luxury resort

facts.text: A mountain-to-table cooking experience has guests harvest produce with the chef and cook traditional Omani dishes over open flame in an outdoor kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Then step into our outdoor kitchen, where you’ll learn to craft traditional Omani dishes using open flame, local spice and time-honored technique.

facts.text: An excursion to Nizwa takes in its markets, its fort and the ancient alleys of Birkat Almouz.
facts.excerpt: From its buzzing markets and storied fort to the ancient alleys of Birkat Almouz, this is history not as lecture, but as living conversation.

facts.text: A via ferrata climbing path is located just beyond the hotel restaurant.
facts.excerpt: the unique via ferrata climbing path, located just beyond the hotel restaurant

facts.text: Non-expert climbers can do the via ferrata safely using a system of fixed cables and bridges; it is an extra cost.
facts.excerpt: The via ferrata experience is an extra cost, but even nonexpert climbers can traverse the terrain safely using a system of fixed cables and bridges.

facts.text: Clear skies make stargazing a highlight.
facts.excerpt: Clear skies in a majestic setting make stargazing a must

facts.text: Complimentary activities rotate and include sunrise or sunset yoga on a platform overlooking the mountains.
facts.excerpt: check out the rotating list of complimentary activities, including sunrise or sunset yoga set on a platform overlooking the mountains

facts.text: The fitness center has dedicated yoga and meditation studios with mountain views.
facts.excerpt: dedicated yoga and meditation studios—all with breathtaking mountain views

facts.text: The Play Alila kids club offers storytelling, locally inspired arts and crafts, and games.
facts.excerpt: For younger guests, delight and entertain with storytelling, locally inspired arts and crafts, and games at Play Alila.

facts.text: Juniper restaurant, named after the juniper trees of Oman's highlands, uses fresh, seasonal local produce.
facts.excerpt: Named after the juniper trees that grow in the highlands of Oman, Juniper Restaurant offers a rich variety of flavours using fresh and seasonal local produce

facts.text: An organic on-property garden supplies a majority of the restaurant's produce.
facts.excerpt: An organic on-property garden supplies a majority of the restaurant’s produce

facts.text: The resort is an EarthCheck-certified property.
facts.excerpt: As an Earth Check-certified property

facts.text: Most of the front office staff are local Omanis who live in nearby villages.
facts.excerpt: Most of the front office staff are local Omani and live in nearby villages

facts.text: Guests are welcomed with Arabic coffee and dates with tahini.
facts.excerpt: Welcome formalities are carried out over Arabic coffee and dates with tahini.

facts.text: Complimentary bikes are available for exploring the resort grounds.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary bikes are also available to guests to meander around the resort grounds.

facts.text: Jabal Akhdar is considered the fruit bowl of Oman, where pomegranates, apricots and roses grow in its Mediterranean-like climate.
facts.excerpt: is considered the fruit bowl of Oman, where pomegranates, apricots and roses grow in abundance in its Mediterranean-like climate

facts.text: The drive from Muscat takes about 2.5 hours.
facts.excerpt: a 2.5-hour journey from Muscat by car

facts.text: A 4x4 vehicle is mandatory for the mountain road.
facts.excerpt: but a 4x4 vehicle is mandatory

facts.text: The property is remote, with not much around it.
facts.excerpt: This is a remote property, with not a whole lot around
